quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare Goldman Sachs communacopia + technology conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Thomas Seifert: at Investor Day Cloudflare raised its North Star from 40% to 50% (rule of 50), will 'exit this year with significant momentum in that direction', and sees a world beyond 2027 'beyond the rule of 50' from the acceleration of Act 3 and Act 4. Q2 upside came from variable consumption - more agentic AI traffic and requests, pool-of-funds customers burning through commitments faster and renewing mid-quarter; with consumption revenue, guidance becomes more difficult ('If you want to keep the range, you have to shift the midpoint'). Agentic AI customers have much shorter sales cycles and bigger deals but need forward-deployed engineers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare Goldman Sachs communacopia + technology conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Thomas Seifert on inference: training is 'not our world, at least not at this point'; Cloudflare's world is inference, where the demand curve 'is really bending when it comes to CPU and memory capacity'. It deploys GPU capacity in pretty much all of its PoPs, has made tremendous progress scheduling inference workloads on CPU capacity, and does not have to provision ahead of demand - capex can go up, but only alongside revenue, and he expects CapEx efficiency to hold for a while. Agentic AI requests carry lower gross margin (token throughput per CPU or GPU) but improving, with low cost to book and cross-sell of sandboxes and AI Gateway. Pretty much all the large AI-native names, 'whether it’s Lovable, Figma, Anthropic, OpenAI', are building on Workers, and about 80% of significant AI enterprise infrastructure is a Cloudflare customer.
quarterly_data.figure: about 80% of significant AI enterprise infrastructure are customers

quarterly_data.quarter: Cloudflare Goldman Sachs communacopia + technology conference 2026 (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CFO Thomas Seifert on Act 4: after Pay Per Crawl, Cloudflare made a research announcement with OpenAI to index what changes on the more than 20% of the web behind it, and announced Monetization Gateways, Cloudflare Wallets and identity tools; it needs to handle 'millions or tens of millions of transactions' of small value and is 'not at the millions yet' (work in progress), with partnerships announced with Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal and Coinbase; the pricing model (take rate or per transaction) is still being worked out. Cloudflare has grown from five products at its IPO to getting to 70, media and publisher share on the network has gone up, and SASE-driven products are accelerating from the baseline; it hired 1,111 interns this year after the Q2 employee reduction and plans to do so again next year.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 20% of the web behind Cloudflare; 70 products; 1,111 interns
